latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of grandpa-skill.

- Capture and preserve personal memories, stories, skills, philosophy, humor, and family role of your grandfather.
- Organizes entries into a living, self-learning portrait using only user-provided data; no external data sources accessed.
- All data stored locally in human-readable Markdown and JSONL files; no cloud or external transmission.
- Designed to honor grief and regret, memorialize lost voices, and help families remember together.
- Includes "What Would Grandpa Say?" mode to offer insights based on your entries.
